notes.title: First release on HELIX
notes.body: Chassis selection, shared weapon heat, weapon sets, burn and slow, drones, new enemy roles, elites, danger levels 0-5, unlocks, audio, settings and a pause menu. The economy was rebalanced: fewer but tougher enemies, scarcer scrap, slower levels and much stronger bosses.

games.name: SCRAPFALL
games.description: A scrapyard survival roguelite. Pick a chassis, survive 100 stages of corrupted scrap creatures while your weapons fire on their own, and turn the scrap they drop into a build. A boss waits every 20 stages.
